description: Reports back on directory listings, many in one call: for each place (by its name from listings_read) say submitted (with the link to the listing, pull request or issue when there is one), listed (it was already there: its link), stopped (where: a sign-in, a robot check, a payment, an email to confirm, terms to accept) or not_for_us (why). Each result stands alone; the answer says what was kept for each. It needs an act key.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

results.description: One result per place, one or more.

directory.description: The place's name as listings_read gives it (or its directoryId).

outcome.description: submitted: sent (Marsell checks each week whether it went live); listed: it was already there, with its link in url; stopped: the try stopped, where in where; not_for_us: this place does not fit, why in where.

url.description: The link to the listing, the pull request or the issue (on the place's own site).

where.description: For stopped: where it stopped (a sign-in, a robot check, a payment, an email to confirm, terms to accept). For not_for_us: why.

name: listings_mark
title: Listings mark
